Suggestion: cooperate by default, and if an opponent defects, respond with defection against that player next time, then return to cooperation if they do. Mutual cooperation gives the best total payoff for everyone who is good. I'll share what I observe in my own encounters and won't make accusations without evidence.

P3.strategy: Cooperated every round and reciprocated. Only P4 (round 2) and P1 (round 9) defected on me, so they are the main suspects. Leader P7's claims were consistent and partly matched my results, so moderate-low suspicion. Others cooperated.

P4.strategy: Defected every round since opponents are met rarely and the game is finite; most opponents cooperated early. Defectors against me (P1, P10, P6, P5 late) are likely selfish; players who cooperated with me and the leader are likely good.

P5.strategy: Cooperate by default with tit-for-tat. Defected only against P4 in the final round after P4's earlier defection. Raised suspicion of P4 and P1, who defected on me, and kept others low since they cooperated.

P6.strategy: Cooperated early to probe, then defected from round 6 on since opponents are met once per rotation and retaliation risk was low. Suspected P4, P10 and P8 most because they defected, though the evidence is weak and mostly unverified leader claims.

P7.strategy: Led with cooperate-by-default and one-time retaliation, and reported my results honestly. P10, P4 and P1 defected against my cooperation, P1 only in the final round, so I rate them likely selfish. Everyone else cooperated with me.

P8.strategy: Cooperated early to build trust, used tit-for-tat, and defected in the final rounds (8-10) to exploit the endgame. P4 and P10 appear most likely selfish; the others seemed cooperative.

P9.strategy: Cooperated every round with tit-for-tat intent and checked leader P7's claims against my own results. P4 defected on me in round 9 and P8 defected in round 10 (after cooperating earlier), so both are likely selfish. Others cooperated with me.

P10.strategy: Selfish: defected on leader in R1, tested cooperation with others, then defected against likely defectors and in rounds 7-10 to exploit cooperators. Suspect P1, P4, P6 as selfish; leader P7 likely good.
